selection_history.correction: Bonferroni-adjusted central bootstrap interval: alpha=0.05/4=0.0125, lower=0.00625, upper=0.99375
selection_history.failure_rule: If rejected, stop all further AH family search on these 8659 fixtures; require a new non-overlapping cohort and a new preregistration.

reason_for_new_family: The rejected conditional_goal_share_logit.v1 applied one common scale to home advantage, attack difference, and defence difference.

Production already contains these three distinct components, so the minimum aligned extension is to estimate one conditional-binomial adjustment per existing component while preserving the accepted TOTALS axis.
This family remains nested in totals_only at three zero adjustments and introduces no new input factor.

forbidden: market odds or lines as model inputs
settled 121 cohort for fit, family choice, threshold choice, or acceptance
market 259 artifact for fit, family choice, threshold choice, or acceptance

fixed_totals_axis.rule: The TOTALS parameters are fixed and may not be refit or changed by this task.

candidate.name: conditional_component_share_logit.v1
candidate.linear_predictor: current_eta + home_adjustment * home_component / fixed_total + attack_adjustment * attack_component / fixed_total + defence_adjustment * defence_component / fixed_total
candidate.monotonicity: Each adjustment is bounded at or above -1.0. Since d(current_eta)/d(component) >= 2/fixed_total and d(adjustment_term)/d(component) >= -1/fixed_total, candidate home share remains strictly increasing in each strength component.
candidate.fit_objective: sum over fixtures of n_goals * log(1 + exp(eta)) - home_goals * eta; zero-goal fixtures contribute zero; this is the conditional binomial share NLL and the share-dependent term of independent-Poisson scoreline NLL when total lambda is fixed

optimizer.method: deterministic Newton-Raphson on the convex three-parameter objective
optimizer.failure: reject; do not switch optimizer, restart, clip the fitted parameters, or redesign after viewing metrics

candidate.outside_bounds: reject; do not clip or refit

comparators.totals_only: fixed accepted TOTALS axis with the current linear delta allocation
comparators.candidate: fixed accepted TOTALS axis plus conditional_component_share_logit.v1

oof.method: expanding prefix strictly before each validation fold

scoring.line_weighting: equal within AH; one fixture is one paired-bootstrap unit
scoring.scoreline_nll: exact independent-Poisson joint NLL, identical to the previous frozen market-axis evaluator
scoring.ah_distribution_support: independent Poisson score matrix on goals 0 through 12 inclusive, normalized exactly as the previous frozen market-axis evaluator

acceptance.fold_improvement_metric: mean AH Brier over the 13 frozen AH lines

decision_rules: Every acceptance item is mandatory; one failure rejects the family.
The Bonferroni-adjusted interval is frozen before fitting because three earlier AH families were viewed on this development dataset.
Passing development OOF authorizes only a local candidate implementation, not a calibration grant, deployment, profitability claim, or production-validity claim.
No metric from the settled 121 or market 259 artifacts may alter this family, fit, gate, or parameter values.
The result is viewed once after this preregistration commit exists; no post-result gate edits are allowed.
A failed family ends all AH model-family search on the frozen 8659 fixtures.
